cards.back:
The system of money, trade and jobs in a country.
Bahasa Indonesia: ekonomi
Example: Farming and tourism are both important to the island's economy.
cards.say: economy. Farming and tourism are both important to the island's economy.

cards.back:
To send goods to be sold in another country.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengekspor
Example: Indonesia can export coffee, rubber and spices to other countries.
cards.say: export. Indonesia can export coffee, rubber and spices to other countries.

cards.back:
To bring goods into a country from another country.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengimpor
Example: We import some wheat because it does not grow well here.
cards.say: import. We import some wheat because it does not grow well here.

cards.back:
The buying and selling of goods.
Bahasa Indonesia: perdagangan
Example: Ancient traders brought spices across the sea for trade.
cards.say: trade. Ancient traders brought spices across the sea for trade.

cards.back:
The wish of people to buy something.
Bahasa Indonesia: permintaan
Example: Demand for umbrellas rises during the rainy season.
cards.say: demand. Demand for umbrellas rises during the rainy season.

cards.back:
The amount of something that is ready to be sold.
Bahasa Indonesia: persediaan
Example: A lack of supply raised the price of rice.
cards.say: supply. A lack of supply raised the price of rice.

cards.back:
To put money into something to earn more later.
Bahasa Indonesia: berinvestasi
Example: Her uncle chose to invest his savings in a small farm.
cards.say: invest. Her uncle chose to invest his savings in a small farm.

cards.back:
Extra money paid for saving or borrowing money.
Bahasa Indonesia: bunga
Example: The bank pays interest on the money in my savings account.
cards.say: interest. The bank pays interest on the money in my savings account.

cards.back:
Money lent to a person that must be paid back.
Bahasa Indonesia: pinjaman
Example: They took out a loan to buy a delivery van.
cards.say: loan. They took out a loan to buy a delivery van.

cards.back:
Money that people pay to the government.
Bahasa Indonesia: pajak
Example: Tax pays for roads, schools and hospitals in every town.
cards.say: tax. Tax pays for roads, schools and hospitals in every town.

cards.back:
A general rise in prices over time.
Bahasa Indonesia: inflasi
Example: Inflation means a loaf of bread costs more than last year.
cards.say: inflation. Inflation means a loaf of bread costs more than last year.

cards.back:
A person who starts a business and takes risks.
Bahasa Indonesia: pengusaha
Example: The young entrepreneur built a business selling handmade paper.
cards.say: entrepreneur. The young entrepreneur built a business selling handmade paper.

cards.back:
A person who owns a small part of a company.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemegang saham
Example: Each shareholder received a letter about the company's yearly results.
cards.say: shareholder. Each shareholder received a letter about the company's yearly results.

cards.back:
A person or company that tries to win the same customers.
Bahasa Indonesia: pesaing
Example: The bakery lowered its prices to beat a nearby competitor.
cards.say: competitor. The bakery lowered its prices to beat a nearby competitor.

cards.back:
To make goods in large numbers, usually in a factory.
Bahasa Indonesia: memproduksi
Example: The factory will manufacture a thousand bicycles every month.
cards.say: manufacture. The factory will manufacture a thousand bicycles every month.

cards.back:
A person who buys and uses goods or services.
Bahasa Indonesia: konsumen
Example: Consumers are asking shops to sell less plastic packaging.
cards.say: consumer. Consumers are asking shops to sell less plastic packaging.

cards.back:
To tell people about a product so they will buy it.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengiklankan
Example: The company paid to advertise its juice on a large poster.
cards.say: advertise. The company paid to advertise its juice on a large poster.

cards.back:
Trade that gives farmers a fair price for their goods.
Bahasa Indonesia: perdagangan adil
Example: We buy fair trade chocolate so that farmers earn a decent wage.
cards.say: fair trade. We buy fair trade chocolate so that farmers earn a decent wage.

cards.back:
The money that a person receives for work or investments.
Bahasa Indonesia: pendapatan
Example: Her income rose when she took a second job at the weekend.
cards.say: income. Her income rose when she took a second job at the weekend.

cards.back:
Money that you must spend on something.
Bahasa Indonesia: pengeluaran
Example: Rent is the biggest expense for most families.
cards.say: expense. Rent is the biggest expense for most families.

cards.back:
Swapping the money of one country for the money of another.
Bahasa Indonesia: penukaran mata uang
Example: Use the currency exchange desk to change your euros to rupiah.
cards.say: currency exchange. Use the currency exchange desk to change your euros to rupiah.

cards.back:
A business owned and run by the people who work in it.
Bahasa Indonesia: koperasi
Example: The village cooperative sells coffee beans for a fair price.
cards.say: cooperative. The village cooperative sells coffee beans for a fair price.

cards.back:
The goods a shop keeps ready to sell.
Bahasa Indonesia: persediaan barang
Example: The shop ran out of stock because of the sale.
cards.say: stock. The shop ran out of stock because of the sale.
